    patterns = [
        ('Cold Water Pit', 'Arrival & Ximending Night Market'),

        ('Beitou · Ninja Legend Escape Room', 'Zhuzihu Hydrangea Cycling'),

    ]
    for old_label, new_label in patterns:
        idx = content.find(old_label)
        if idx >= 0:
            # Find the full line containing this label
            start = content.rfind('\n#day-entry-toc(', 0, idx)
            end = content.find('\n', content.find(old_label) + len(old_label))
